> This documents the development of dvn 2.0.

## Creating a new console application project

Created a new console application project in Visual Studio, and named it "dvn". The project is located in the `src` directory.

## Adding the PowerShell SDK

Added the `Microsoft.PowerShell.SDK` to the project using the NuGet Package Manager. This allows us to run PowerShell scripts and commands from our C# code.

## The `Du` framework

* Created a `Du/` folder to hold all the code related to the Du framework.
* Created a new file named `Du.Internet.cs` in the `Du/` folder. This file will contain all the code related to internet stuff like downloads, web requests, etc.

## The `Scoop` framework

Created a `Scooper/` folder to hold all the code related to the Scoop framework.
